name: WA construction apprentice tool allowance
summary: WA construction apprentices and trainees can claim back money spent on tools and safety gear at the start and end of training.
key: Up to $1,000 reimbursement at commencement and up to $1,000 at completion for tools or safety equipment.
who: WA construction apprentices and trainees who start between 1 July 2024 and 30 June 2029
how: Register and claim through the CTF Portal with your tax invoice and bank details.
catches: Commencement claim within 11 months of starting; completion claim within 6 months of finishing.

source.label: Construction Training Fund: Apprentice tool allowance

evidence.quote: Receive up to $1,000 reimbursement for the purchase of work-related tools
Apprentices and trainees who commence their construction related apprenticeship between 1 July 2024 and 30 June 2029 may be eligible.
